input.body:
label: bug
file: none

The Monday weekly summary email appears to be scheduled using a timezone offset that doesn't correctly account for users in timezones far ahead of UTC (like Sydney, UTC+10/11), while it works correctly for users closer to UTC (like London). This points to the scheduling/dispatch logic computing "Monday" in the wrong reference timezone (likely server/UTC time instead of the recipient's account timezone), causing the email to be queued or sent a day late for users east of the reference timezone. We were unable to locate the specific scheduling job/module in the index to pinpoint the exact file; a search for the email-scheduling code (e.g. for terms like "summary" job scheduling, cron, or timezone conversion logic) is needed to confirm and fix the root cause.
